effect.shortEffect: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
effect.full: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

french.sv: Le pouvoir de l’épée qui appelle le fléau affaiblit\nla Défense de tous les autres Pokémon.

english.sv: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

japanese.sv: 災厄を　呼ぶ　剣の力で 自分以外の　防御が　弱くなる。
